**Hi there!**  
I’ll help you set up a clean, safe website for your dog‑walking business.  
Since it’s just a simple landing page with no logins, payments or personal data, it’s a **Green** project—easy and quick, and we won’t touch any keys or secrets.

---

### One‑screen plan

```
What we are building: A one‑page “Dog Walking” website.
Who uses it: Local dog owners in your community.   Risk level: Green
Day‑one features: 1. A friendly banner with your business name 2. A short “About” section 3. A contact form (email only) 4. A simple photo carousel of happy dogs

Information it stores: None (the contact form will send an email, no database needed)
Logins: None
Money: None
Built with: 📦  Static HTML5, CSS3, a touch of JavaScript for the form and carousel (so you can host it on GitHub Pages or Netlify for free)
Steps:
1. Confirm a few details (name, colors, contact email, a photo or two you want displayed)
2. I’ll give you the folder structure, files and exact content
3. You’ll copy the files into a folder (or zip them), upload to a hosting platform, and the site will be live
Safety: No secrets entered, no database rules, just a simple, secure static site
Not in version 1: Analytics, sign‑ups, bookings or payments
```

**Does this look right?**  
If anything needs changing, just let me know. If it’s fine, reply “yes” and I’ll ask the quick starter questions.
